text: Exchange of information about themselves, right? To help the station access point, to get to know each other, takes place, by means of a packet that is called association request frame frame in Wi-Fi means packet. Okay. Whenever you see frame, you can read it as packet. Um, the station will send a packet called association request for access point with some information about itself, and the access point will reply with a packet called association response, communicating of course some information about itself. Now an important, very important information that the access point includes in this response to the user, is also, the minimum data rate at which users need to communicate within that BSS. So the access point can be configured to work at minimum physical data rate. Remember the previous table that we showed, there was the maximum indicated, right? But every access point can also set a minimum, so it doesn't want, for example, slow users. It may want to admit only users that are fast enough above threshold. This minimum data rate is called basic data rate. Okay. So the access point can say.
